title.narrative: PROTECTING AND EMPOWERING GIRLS TO REACH THEIR FULL POTENTIAL (PROTECT PHASE TWO)

description.narrative: The project will continue to strengthen the institutional capacity of the National Secretariat for the Reduction of Adolescent Pregnancy and Child Marriage Secretariat (NSRAPCM) and Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education (MBSSE) to deliver on their mandates. The project will support development of a new National Strategy for Reduction of Adolescent Pregnancy and Child Marriage (2024-2029) including coordination and M and E activities and support MBSSE to further roll out Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE) through implementing the new integrated curriculum in fifty pilot schools in Koinadugu and Pujehun.
